name: Live Artifacts
summary: Pages your agents make from their work: kept, refreshed from the data you approve, and shared with a link you control.
description: Live Artifacts keeps a good agent answer as a page you can open again, not a chat message. An agent writes one small HTML page against a fixed contract and proposes its data sources; you approve each source once, with the exact read on screen. The page then refreshes on a schedule from the apps you approved (for example Task Board and Knowledge), even after the agent is gone. Every change is a new version you can roll back. Pages run in a sandbox with no network. Values read from your apps are shown to you, never returned to agents.

intents: turn an agent answer into a page
keep a dashboard my agents made
a live page that refreshes from my tasks
share a report page with a link
at a glance view of my company
publish agent output as a page

operations.title: Create a live page
operations.description: Save your output as a live page instead of pasting it into chat. view.html is one self-contained HTML file (no network). contract.inputs proposes data sources: kind push = data you send later with artifact_data_put; kind read = a read of another app (for example kanban issues_list) that the owner must approve before it refreshes. contract.triggers proposes a refresh schedule (owner approves). fromId copies another page you can read (its HTML and source proposals; copied sources need approval again). Returns the page id and a review link for the owner.

operations.title: Update a live page
operations.description: Change a live page: title, description, contract or HTML. New HTML or a new contract makes a new version; older versions stay. A changed data source needs the owner's approval again. expectedVersion refuses the update (version_conflict) if someone changed the page since you read it. On a page that is shared with a link, the new version waits for the owner (staged) unless the owner lets agents publish.

operations.title: Delete a live page
operations.description: Delete a live page with all its versions, data and links. Needs manage access to its gallery. The owner approves the deletion.

operations.title: Push data to a live page
operations.description: Send fresh data (JSON, at most 256 KiB) for one push source of a live page. The page shows it at once and labels it "pushed by" you. On a page that is shared with a link, the data waits for the owner (staged) unless the owner lets agents publish.

operations.title: Refresh a live page now
operations.description: Ask for a refresh of a live page now (at most once a minute per page). Only sources the owner approved are read. Returns the status of each source, never its data.

operations.title: Share a live page with a link
operations.description: Ask for a viewer link to a live page: anyone who has the link can open the page without an account until it ends or the owner revokes it. The owner approves the link first (hold family public_link). The link address is in the answer of the approved retry only; repeat the same call with the same idempotency key after approval. At most 5 active links per page and 50 per workspace. Answers link_needs_hold (403) while your card does not hold public_link, and view_origin_missing (409) while the bridge has no viewer address.

label.description: A name for this link, for example the person who gets it (at most 40 characters).

expiresInDays.description: Days until the link ends. Default: the owner's setting (7 days unless the owner changed it).

pin.description: A version number to show on this link for its whole life, or null (default) to follow the live version.

operations.title: Make a version of a shared page live
operations.description: Make a version live for the people who hold a link: promote the staged version (and the staged pushed data you list), or roll back to an older version. The owner approves it first (hold family public_link) and sees the size, digest, data keys and sources that change. List each staged key with the digest artifact_data_put gave you in data; staged data you do not list stays staged. Answers link_needs_hold (403) while your card does not hold public_link, staged_changed (409) if listed data changed after you asked.

data.description: Staged pushed data to publish with the version: each key with the digest artifact_data_put returned.

operations.title: Revoke a viewer link
operations.description: Stop a viewer link at once: its address answers not found from now on. Agents may always narrow who can see a page, so this is never held. Needs update access to the gallery of the page.

operations.title: Page detail
operations.description: One live page for the owner: live version HTML, versions, sources with their state, links with view counts, and recent activity.

operations.title: Preview a page
operations.description: Mint a 10-minute preview link for one version (default: the staged version, else the live one) on the viewer address. Send no idempotency key: the URL is a secret and is never stored. Answers view_origin_missing (409) while the bridge has no viewer address.

operations.title: Test a data source
operations.description: One live sample read of a proposed source through this app's read-only grant (first rows only), so the owner sees what the page would get before approving it.

operations.title: Approve a data source
operations.description: Approve exactly this binding (its digest). viewers = also show its data to people with a viewer link. Refused with digest_changed if the binding changed since the owner looked.

operations.title: Revoke a data source
operations.description: Withdraw the approval of a source and delete its stored data.

operations.title: Approve the refresh schedule
operations.description: Approve, change (300 to 86400 seconds) or switch off (null) the refresh schedule of a page; also resumes a page that stopped after repeated failures.

operations.title: Make a version live
operations.description: Make a version live: promote the staged version and staged data, or roll back to an older version.

data.description: Also publish staged pushed data (default true).

operations.title: Let agents change a shared page
operations.description: owner (default): on a shared page, agent changes wait for you. agent: agent changes go live at once.

operations.title: Create a viewer link
operations.description: The owner creates a viewer link for a page (no hold: the owner is the approver). The address is in the answer; the app stores only its digest. At most 5 active links per page and 50 per workspace. Answers view_origin_missing (409) while the bridge has no viewer address.

label.description: A name for this link, for example the person who gets it (at most 40 characters).

expiresInDays.description: Days until the link ends. Default: the owner's setting (7 days unless the owner changed it).

pin.description: A version number to show on this link for its whole life, or null (default) to follow the live version.

operations.title: Revoke a viewer link
operations.description: Stop a viewer link at once: its address answers not found from now on.

operations.title: Every viewer link
operations.description: All viewer links of all pages, newest first (at most 200): the Links page. Addresses are never listed.

operations.title: Archive a page
operations.description: Archive or restore a page. An archived page keeps its versions and data, does not refresh, and its links stop working.

harnessHints.instructions: When your answer is a report, table or dashboard the owner will want to open again, save it with live-artifacts__artifact_create (one self-contained HTML file, no network) instead of pasting it. Propose data sources in contract.inputs; the owner approves them. Use live-artifacts__artifact_data_put to push fresh numbers. Ask for a viewer link with live-artifacts__artifact_share: the owner approves it, and the link address comes in the answer to the approved retry (same call, same idempotency key).
